effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with ＜Blocker＞ or 1 Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When the attack target is switched, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
